opening.argument: The segment is framed as an ABC Action News consumer report about alleged Walmart gift-card value theft. A customer describes a card being redeemed in Pinellas Park five hours after purchase and being told it had a zero balance. The reporter-led presentation, news graphics, interviews, and store coverage place those accounts in a reporting context. The report also says the company shared surveillance video and card information with law enforcement, reinforcing that it is documenting and warning about the alleged theft. Nothing in that framing solicits money, gift cards, or services from viewers; the evidence supports a consumer warning, not a pitch.

citations.quote: Thieves have found a way to empty Wal-Mart gift cards
five hours after I made the purchase, it was redeemed in Pinellas Park.
THEY WERE TOLD THAT THERE WAS A ZERO-BALANCE ON IT.
THE COMPANY SAYS THEY'VE SHARED SURVEILLANCE VIDEO AND CARDS INFORMATION WITH LAW ENFORCEMENT
